columns.name: TM_AUDIT_ATRB_ID
columns.description: Primary Key column containing a random generated number

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TM_AUDIT_ID
columns.description: Reference to a row of the Time audit table

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Action performed on the attribute

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Code referencing a Lookup value

columns.name: TM_ATRB_FLD_ID
columns.description: Id of the Time attribute updated if ACTION_TYPE = Update

columns.name: TM_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the attribute : Number, Varchar, Timestamp, Date

columns.name: OLD_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp,Timestamp value of the attribute before change

columns.name: OLD_ZONE_TYPE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the type of time zone for the value of the attribute before change. Possible values : OFFSET, ZONE, NULL

columns.name: OLD_GMT_OFFSET
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the time zone offset in milliseconds for the value of the attribute before change

columns.name: OLD_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the time zone code for the value of the attribute before change

columns.name: NEW_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp,Timestamp value of the attribute after change

columns.name: NEW_ZONE_TYPE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the type of time zone for the value of the attribute after change. Possible values : OFFSET, ZONE, NULL

columns.name: NEW_GMT_OFFSET
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the time zone offset in milliseconds for the value of the attribute after change.

columns.name: NEW_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Timestamp, contain the time zone code for the value of the attribute after change.

columns.name: OLD_VARCHAR
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Varchar, value of the attribute before change

columns.name: NEW_VARCHAR
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Varchar, value of the attribute after change

columns.name: OLD_DATE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Date, value of the attribute before change

columns.name: NEW_DATE
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Date, value of the attribute after change

columns.name: OLD_NUMBER
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Number, value of the attribute before change

columns.name: NEW_NUMBER
columns.description: if ACTION_TYPE = Update and ATTRIBUTE_TYPE = Number, value of the attribute after change
